notes.title: MARTHA IS DEAD IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome To Tuscany[/h1]

The time has finally arrived! 
Martha Is Dead is now... err. LIVE on Steam!

You can catch our chilling launch trailer right here 

[previewyoutube=2KN1qelGiTk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't already - get yourself over to the store page now where our launch stream is well underway, featuring some behind the scenes footage, competitions, and streams of the game from content creators around the world!

On top of the launch we've got a couple of extra things to update you on, so let's get stuck into them so you can get playing!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

Yes there is a day one patch! It fixes lots of small bugs and gives everything a layer of polish and a performance boost, for those that like knowing what's included - here's the list :

- Game content brought up to date, encompassing hundreds of gameplay fixes.
- Hundreds of console specific fixes and polish items.
- Lighting rebuilt to rectify obvious issues.
- Stability drastically improved.
- Old gen console graphics enhanced, textures are now clearer.
- Skip optional functionality added to sensitive scenes
- Performance improved for all platforms 

Should there be any bugs or issues encountered during play - don't panic!
Get yourself over to our Discord and ask for assistance in the support channel - or hit us up on our Twitter DM's with your issue and we'll investigate it ASAP

You can find our Discord here : [url=https://discord.gg/wiredp]Wired Discord[/url]
And our Twitter account here : [url=https://twitter.com/WiredP]Wired Twitter[/url]

We'll be collecting all of peoples known issues and bugs shortly after launch and will provide an FAQ / Known issues bug collection post in the forums here once we can see what isn't a one off occurrence - so help us help you with that feedback!

[h2]Competitions [/h2]

It wouldn't be a Wired launch without a healthy dose of competition goodness to go with it!

We'll have multiple social competitions dropping on our socials over the next few days, focusing on some nifty peripherals and gaming gear, so be sure to keep your eyes on all our socials listed at the bottom of this post!

However we have three 'big' competitions coming off the back of the launch - where you can win a steamdeck, a 3080 video card, or for the superfan, a vinyl player, rare test pressing of the OST and some hand made marionette dolls! 

(There is also some super scret code hidden in our launch stream loop that will give you lots of bonus entries for the Steam Deck comp)

You can find the links to these below :

Win a Steam Deck : [url=https://gleam.io/uV4fk/steam-deck-giveaway]Competition[/url]
Win an Nvidia 3080 : [url=https://gleam.io/9nJBT/founders-edition-nvidia-rtx-3080-graphics-card]Competition [/url]
Win a Vinyl Player, Test Pressing and Marionettes : [url=https://gleam.io/BCHpt/win-a-vinyl-player-test-press-and-hand-made-marionette-puppets]Competition [/url]

Good luck! 

[h2]Thank you [/h2]

And finally, thank you - every single one of you - from the OG Town Of Light fans, to those that have joined over the course of Martha development, to those that played the demo and gave feedback and everyone in between!

This project is a special one, Luca and the team at LKA really poured their heart and soul into the game, and we feel privileged to be able to help them get their story and world out for you all to play!

There will be a special edition of Martha Uncovered later today with some words from the team themselves at the finishing line, so keep an eye out for that - but in the meantime, if you have played the game, PLEASE LEAVE A REVIEW! An honest one! It helps so much more than you'll know, and is the absolute best way to support developers of games you've enjoyed!

Now, stop reading this and go get playing! Take lots of screenshots and photos and share them with us... they might have use in a little while ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/515960/Martha_Is_Dead/

Learn more about Martha Uncovered and the rest of #WiredLive content on the Wired website : [url=https://wiredproductions.com/wired-live/]Wired Live Site[/url]

notes.title: The Town of Light Enhanced update is now available for everyone
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to be able to share that to coincided with today’s console release of The Town of Light published by Wired Productions, we’ve just activated an update to bring all the new content to steam players, for FREE! This is a thank you for all your support on our project, The update brings new story elements, graphical improvements, new VO and an amazing score!
 
We’ve also just released a collector’s edition, which can be viewed here: 
[url=https://shop.wiredproductions.com/collections/the-town-of-light]Wired Productions Shop[/url]
 
Thank you for all your support so far!

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now find the parts of the Renée’s Diary inside the game
[*]Renée’s Diary is now accessible in the Synopsis menu
[*]2 new achievements related to Renée’s Diary
[*]New hallucination experience
[*]New documents added
[*]New historical photos added
[*]Controller vibration added
[*]Reworked and optimized vegetation with autumn look
[*]Reworked elevator and several assets
[*]Reworked textures
[*]Voiceover extended
[*]Improved performance
[*]Lower loading time with percentage
[*]New UI system
[*]New Title screen menu
[*]New animated credits screen 
[*]Added the song “Soley - I Will Find you”
[*]The menu will show which story path you are going down, based on the choices you have made so far.
[*]Added more drawings triggerable by objects inside the asylum
[*]Live action trailer accessible from the main menu (at the end of the game)
[*]Quit alert added
[*]Alienware plugin added
[*]NVIDIA Ansel supported
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Lightning in some areas
[*]Audio in certain scenes
[*]Fix light while visualizing object.
[*]The text “Inspired by” was overlapping after loading the first chapter.
[*]Audio fixes for greenhouse drawings and bench memories.
[*]Gamma setup screen fixed
[*]Fix post-processing effects for old refectory scene (with former patients).
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
Update 28th October 2016

Hi everyone, we have madee several improvements to the game for the Halloween Steam sale.

Improvements:
- VR mode included in the main branch
- Many documents are now skippable after unlocking the following chapter
- Performance optimizations
- Vegetation reworked
- Reworked object visualization
- Pointer reworked
- Gamma calibration reworked
- Sky reworked
- All Gui is now high resolution even at low quality settings

Fixes:
- Fix bug preventing to play certain sounds completely
- Fix bug that prevent to continue the game if exiting the graveyard before certain events.
- Illumination fixed in some rooms
- Corrected some minor typos

- Many documents are now skippable after unlocking the following chapter

notes.title: Patch 1.51: New English localization
notes.content:
Hi all, due to the high number of feedbacks, we decided to rework the English translation and the voice acting.

Our Art director, Luca Dalcò, went to Rome in “Local Transit”, a professional recording studio, to supervise the actress performance, with the kind collaboration of Angela Paoletti, managing director for Local Transit (Everybody’s gone to the rapture, DC Universe, Everquest II).

We feel the voice acting is very important for our game in order to create the right mood. The Town of Light deserves a great voice acting, now we are very satisfied with the result.

We can’t wait to hear your new feedbacks.

[h1]Other improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Audio Polishes
[*]The maze has been reworked with new assets
[*]Performance optimization
[*]Improved gamepad controls
[/list]

tags.feature: - The maze has been reworked with new assets

notes.title: Support for Oculus CV1
notes.content:
The Town of Light , has been updated to support Oculus Rift CV1!
The update is available on Steam for free to everyone that already owns the game.
You can find it in a new build just by switching the branch. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/433100/discussions/1/458607699621312806/]Here are the infos to enable it.[/url] 

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance issues
[/list]
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Better UI
[*]FOV dependent on VR devices
[/list]
To celebrate this, we are offering a 25% discount for new players until the 16th of May.

notes.content:

[h1][b]New[/b][/h1]
- Renèe's diary now readable in the game

- Spanish translation (beta)

[h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1]
- Area performance improvements
- Scene optimizations to reduce stuttering - Much more to come in a later patch
- Improved movement controls
- Easier drawings achievement
- More exploration drawings

[h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1]
- Fixed sitting animation bug
- The merry go round animation is now smooth
- Fixed rare chapters menu scrolling issue
- Fix Oreste Bachecco achievement not unlocking in some cases 
- Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: The Town of Light - Extras will be available at no cost for the game owners in the first two weeks
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/444040/]The Town of Light - Extras[/url] dlc will be available at no cost for any owner of the game during the first two weeks following the release date.

The package contains the following:

[list]
[*]Official Soundtrack
[*]Artbook
[*]Renèes's Diary
[/list]

Install the dlc during the promotion and it will be yours forever at no cost.
